title: The Master Synthesis: Complete Evolutionary Flow of Derivatives
prerequisites: Basic understanding of forward contracts, futures, and options
Familiarity with Black-Scholes-Merton pricing and the Greeks
learningOutcomes: Trace the historical transition from bilateral forwards to standardized futures.
Analyze why rolling short-dated futures caused the 1993 Metallgesellschaft liquidity crisis.
Apply the continuous cost-of-carry forward pricing formula F0 = S0 * exp((r - q)T).
Demonstrate why Black-Scholes-Merton dynamic delta hedging eliminates stock drift mu.
Synthesize multi-dimensional Greek risk management and post-1987 volatility smiles.

sections.title: Historical Origins & Clearinghouse Standardization
sections.pedagogicalObjective: Explain why counterparty default in 1848 forced the creation of CBOT standardized futures.

sections.title: Linear Hedging vs Asymmetric Option Protection
sections.pedagogicalObjective: Contrast linear futures lock-in against non-linear option convexity.

sections.title: The 1973 BSM Revolution & The Greeks
sections.pedagogicalObjective: Explain risk-neutral valuation and multi-dimensional Greek risk management.

sections.title: Black Monday 1987 & The Volatility Smile
sections.pedagogicalObjective: Explain why constant volatility fails and how the volatility smile captures fat tails.
